name: Bob Latham
occupation: Crook County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Crook County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election; lost the August 2026 Republican primary)
background: Bob Latham is a Crook County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election, and the official elected officials page lists him as a member. The Sundance Times reported that he received 562 votes in the August 2026 Republican primary. Incoming commissioner Keith Haiar takes office in January 2027.
